description: This file implements URL parsing and encoding/decoding functions within the Thunder namespace, including URL class methods for parsing URL components, encoding, decoding, and base64 operations.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A class for parsing and constructing URLs, handling components like scheme, host, path, query, and ref.

methods.name: URL::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a string into URL-encoded format.

methods.name: URL::Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into Base64 string.

methods.name: URL::Base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into binary data.

methods.name: URL::Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components.

methods.name: URL::ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL, extracting host and port.

methods.name: URL::Text
methods.description: Constructs the full URL string from components.
